official_provider_semantics.paraphrase: An explicit asof identifies the underlying entity for the requested symbol on that date. Historical bars can include a previous symbol while remaining labeled with the requested symbol. Qualification therefore additionally requires an accepted exact asof anchor and matching dated CIK and both FIGIs. Missing or disabled asof cannot support this alias-continuity path.
